summary: Implemented the versioned Angular compatibility preflight and completed the exceptional DS2-R3 correction for supported npm/Yarn consumers: unrecognized Yarn lockfile content now produces an explicit lockfile_unreadable diagnostic before package.json fallback; pnpm lockfiles are ignored.

evidence.description: Versioned source of truth for the Angular 22 consumer policy and tested TypeScript release.
Pure inspector with manifest, npm/Yarn lockfile and installed-package precedence; validates the minimum recognized Yarn structure without invoking package managers.
Built-artifact tests for Node, Angular, TypeScript, Tailwind, Spartan, valid and unreadable lockfiles, no-write doctor behavior and JSON diagnostics.
Published compatibility table and troubleshooting guidance.

validation.details: Angular suite: 31 passed; React suite: 32 passed. Regressions cover arbitrary yarn.lock content, preserve the explicit diagnostic and verify doctor does not alter the lockfile. The source and shipped artifacts contain no pnpm lockfile support.

limitations: The lockfile reader supports npm package-lock/shrinkwrap, Yarn Classic/Berry and pnpm package entries, but intentionally treats malformed or non-provable specifiers as blockers rather than resolving consumer code.
No release, tag, publication, push, pull request, or ClickManager application change was performed.
